code_rule: Strip outer whitespace; exact eleven ASCII digits only, equal to primary native2021 NP code; no prefix/parent/old-code substitution or splitting multicodes.
name_rule: Casefold, yo-to-ye, whitespace collapse and Unicode dash equivalence only. No transliteration, fuzzy names, numeric or geographic suffix deletion. Exact at least one own source name.
census_guard: Native NP code and id unique in complete primary2021 census frame, exact code primary parent bridge preserved.
A1: Exactly one source object asserts code, it is a source node in permitted settlement-place classes with finite original coordinate and exact name; explicit source region/parent disagreements retained for review, not silently ignored.
A2_review: One coordinate node plus additional same-code source objects; no automatic adoption, preserve every coded source object to establish whether genuine conflicting coordinate/identity assertions exist.
source_formal_type: OSM generic place class is not legal formal settlement subtype; retain census formal type and source place category separately. Explicit Russian subtype assertions must be reviewed against primary type; no invented formal subtype.
status_policy: All outputs are source candidate evidence only. Guardian source/frame review required before future versioned adoption; current accepted axis and existing over10km failures remain unchanged.
